description: This file declares data types and functions for bitstream manipulation used in video codecs, including bit reading, writing, skipping, and variable length coding/decoding, specifically for ARM architecture.

methods.name: armLookAheadBits
methods.description: Retrieves the next N bits from the bitstream without advancing the pointer.

methods.name: armGetBits
methods.description: Reads N bits from the bitstream and advances the pointer.

methods.name: armByteAlign
methods.description: Aligns the bitstream pointer to the next byte boundary.

methods.name: armSkipBits
methods.description: Skips N bits in the bitstream.

methods.name: armUnPackVLC32
methods.description: Decodes a variable length code from the bitstream using a codebook.

methods.name: armPackBits
methods.description: Packs a code word into the bitstream.

methods.name: armPackVLC32
methods.description: Encodes a variable length code into the bitstream.
